summary: Processed all 16 open supplier-onboarding requests in id order under the policy, checks and exceptions in force on 2026-09-14: 5 onboarded (1604, 1611, 1612, 1616, 1618), 6 pending (approvals or trial delivery), 2 rejected (1617 trial failed, 1620 item not eligible) and 2 duplicates (1621, 1623), with trial-unit transfers and the 1617 return booked under ONB-<id>. Some policy and check lines were only readable as truncated search snippets, so a few rules were inferred (for example the 10% tolerance boundary).
